name: Cable Woodchop
cues: Set the pulley high and stand side-on in a wide stance
Keep your arms long as you pull down and across
Turn your hips and torso together, pivoting on the foot nearest the stack
Finish low outside your far hip and return under control

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-01 (bulk approval of every pending exercise). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Family review 2026-10-01 rated minor. repaired: see repair report | skeptic after repair: The repair fixed the pivot foot and the finish grip. In feet/figure-809-foot_R.png at t=0, 0.125 and 0.875 the ball is planted, the heel is up and the toes are flat. At the finish both fists wrap the bar. The top of the chop (t=0.375 to 0.75) was not fixed. In hands-yaw/figure-809-wrist_R-yaw-60.png at t=0.5 and 0.625 the right fingers are splayed, with the D-handle rod passing between them. In hands-yaw/figure-809-wrist_L-yaw60.png at t=0.375 the fingers lie extended across the grip instead of wrapping it. In hands/figure-809-wrist_L.png at t=0.5 to 0.75 the upper hand's fingers point up past the end cap. Also at t=0.375 in the hero, the handle carabiner and cable end sit right at the chin (scratchpad refute-F9-visual/809-t375-hands.png). At 480 px the start grip still reads as holding (809-t5-hands.png), so this is minor, but it does not meet "hands closed on handles" across the loop, so I reject the repair agent's ok. Highlight (obliques primary, abs secondary), stance, and hips and torso turning together are all right.
